posts.title: Competition and Differentiation
posts.description: Remember when everyone in the 2010s was making messenger apps and video streaming platforms? Remember in 2000s everyone was making comment systems and friending? Remember in 2026 when everyone was making agents? Remember when so many of those companies all found their own niches and the industries collectively found the min-bar for quality then differentiated after that. We’re still so early - kee

posts.title: Feature of the Week: Triage Bot
posts.description: Feature of the week: I've been experimenting with an agent that triages straight out of Slack, asks follow-ups, routes and files issues into Linear via Highlight. Everyone just wants to post issues in Slack. Why fight it? To make a great product you really need people posting as many bugs as possible. This got us there internally and really helped us close the loop on issues that were filed too. M
